faq.q: What is the origin of Wasim?
faq.a: Wasim is associated with Arabic. Wasim is Arabic وَسِيم (Wasīm), meaning 'handsome, good-looking'.
Yes — the underlying form وَسِيم is Arabic.
Wasim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
